shortDescription: Module for setup of VSDataScriptSet Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: created_by
options.description: Creator name. Field introduced in 17.1.11,17.2.4. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: datascript
options.description: Datascripts to execute. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: description
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: geo_db_ref
options.description: Geo location mapping database used by this datascriptset. It is a reference to an object of type geodb. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ip_reputation_db_ref
options.description: Ip reputation database that can be used by datascript functions. It is a reference to an object of type ipreputationdb. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ipgroup_refs
options.description: Uuid of ip groups that could be referred by vsdatascriptset objects. It is a reference to an object of type ipaddrgroup. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the virtual service datascript collection. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: pki_profile_refs
options.description: Uuids of pkiprofile objects that could be referred by vsdatascriptset objects. It is a reference to an object of type pkiprofile. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: pool_group_refs
options.description: Uuid of pool groups that could be referred by vsdatascriptset objects. It is a reference to an object of type poolgroup. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: pool_refs
options.description: Uuid of pools that could be referred by vsdatascriptset objects. It is a reference to an object of type pool. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: protocol_parser_refs
options.description: List of protocol parsers that could be referred by vsdatascriptset objects. It is a reference to an object of type protocolparser. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: rate_limiters
options.description: The rate limit definitions needed for this datascript. The name is composed of the virtual service name and the datascript name. Field introduced in 18.2.9. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: snat_ip6s
options.description: Ipv6 address used by a vs-datascript in avi.l4.source_ip api. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Maximum of 8 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: snat_ips
options.description: Ipv4 address used by a vs-datascript in avi.l4.source_ip api. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Maximum of 8 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ssl_key_certificate_refs
options.description: Uuids of sslkeyandcertificate objects that could be referred by vsdatascriptset objects. It is a reference to an object of type sslkeyandcertificate. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ssl_profile_refs
options.description: Uuids of sslprofile objects that could be referred by vsdatascriptset objects. It is a reference to an object of type sslprofile. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: string_group_refs
options.description: Uuid of string groups that could be referred by vsdatascriptset objects. It is a reference to an object of type stringgroup. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the virtual service datascript collection. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
